headline: L1 consensus store: 18,836/18,853 union targets covered across 23 KD stores; self-KD z_hat negative for 94.3% of measured targets (median -4.97)

audit_flags.message: run h204-20261121-01 pooled two overexpression arms into KD consensus (datlinger17 crop-oe via '-oe' suffix gap, norman19 sc-oe); tokenized assay exclusion fixed in run -02. Run -01 retained on volume but marked superseded.
lfc_hat pooled only within each target's primary lfc_kind (log1p-sc / log1p-norm / norm-mean-diff / log2fc-publisher); z_hat pools across all stores -- units never mixed
v0 uses uniform source multipliers; PSEUDOREP stores contribute via their honest SEs only. LOLO-fitted weights are k205+.
guide-level bulk stores have ~0.4% finite-SE cells; they contribute lfc magnitude but few z votes
median tau2_z = 0 even on multi-source cells: most genes are null in every screen; disagreement concentrates in true-DE tails (i2 signal lives there)
